description: Native printer output for generated names, emit helpers, text sources, snippet tab stops and the parentheses parenthesizeExpressionForNoAsi creates. Each case parses `source` as /main.ts (/main.tsx with `jsx`), binds it with `bind`, rewrites markers with the emit context's node visitor ($temp, $loop, $affixed, $unique_<n>, $optimistic_<n>, $filelevel_<n>, $helper_<n>, $nlhelper_<n> (a helper name flagged StartOnNewLine), $node_<n>, $decl_<i> (the generated name for top-level statement i), $strtemp, $strunique_<n>, $strtext_<t> and $strascii_<t> (a string literal whose text source is an identifier <t>, the second flagged NoAsciiEscaping), string literals "$strjsx_<t>" and "$strasciijsx_<t>" likewise, a JSX attribute value "$strns" (the attribute name as text source), #unique_<n>, $lastpee and $lastpae (the last partially emitted expression or property access the visitor produced, shared); functions named reuse* get ReuseTempVariableScope; `pee` turns parenthesized expressions into partially emitted ones; `tab_stops` gives each empty statement a tab-stop snippet), records the helpers and flags, and prints the file `writes` times with one printer (NeverAsciiEscape from `never_ascii_escape`). With `listener`, a last entry lists each node of the printed tree in pre-order with the writer positions OnBeforeEmitNode and OnAfterEmitNode recorded for it, or - when they were not called with it.
producer: tools/phase3/printer_witness/a1_witness_test.go, overlaid into tsc/internal/printer and run as TestA1Witness
